name: Classic Fluffy Pancakes
instructions: Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt together in a large bowl.
Make a well in the center and pour in the milk, melted butter, and egg.
Mix just until smooth; do not overmix.
Heat a lightly oiled griddle over medium-high heat.
Pour batter onto the griddle and brown on both sides. Serve hot.

name: Garden Herb Omelette
instructions: Whisk the eggs, herbs, salt, and pepper together in a small bowl until completely blended.
Melt the butter in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Pour in the egg mixture. Let it set slightly, then gently lift the edges to let raw egg run underneath.
When the top is mostly set but still slightly damp, sprinkle cheese over one half.
Fold the omelette in half, slide it onto a plate, and enjoy.

name: Creamy Tomato Basil Pasta
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne according to package directions.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté the minced garlic for 1 minute.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and simmer gently for 10 minutes.
Stir in the heavy cream and half of the parmesan cheese, allowing it to heat through for 2 minutes.
Drain the pasta and toss it directly into the sauce along with the fresh basil. Top with remaining parmesan.
